g1|variants|sto.family_title: Stock Transport Order (STO) Family from OTC Perspective
g1|variants|sto.summary: Stock Transport Orders manage the physical and financial movement of goods between different plants within or across company codes, directly impacting OTC fulfillment schedules, delivery creation, and billing. The variants differ primarily by cross-company financial settlement requirements, delivery processing steps, and goods movement execution types.

variants.name: Inter-company STO with Delivery and Billing
variants.when_used: Transferring stock between plants belonging to different company codes, requiring a formal sales billing document and inter-company accounts receivable/payable posting.
variants.key_config: Customizing inter-company customer-vendor relationships, assigning billing type IV to delivery type NLCC, and setting up pricing procedure for inter-company billing.

variants.name: Intra-company STO with Delivery
variants.when_used: Transferring stock between two plants within the same company code using LE outbound deliveries and shipping execution without financial billing.
variants.key_config: Assigning delivery type NL to supplying plant and receiving plant combination, and configuring shipping point determination.

variants.name: Intra-company STO without Delivery (One-Step)
variants.when_used: Simple plant-to-plant transfers within the same company code where goods issue and goods receipt happen simultaneously via a single material movement.
variants.key_config: Item category configuration allowing one-step movement without shipping processing or outbound delivery creation.

variants.name: Intra-company STO without Delivery (Two-Step)
variants.when_used: Plant-to-plant transfers within the same company code with explicit intermediate transit stock monitoring using two separate material movements.
variants.key_config: Item category setting enforcing two-step goods movement procedure (removal from storage and placement into storage).

variants.name: Advanced Intercompany Stock Transfer
variants.when_used: Complex multi-step cross-company transfer leveraging Advanced Available-to-Promise (aATP), automated billing, and enhanced monitoring for transit valuation.
variants.key_config: Activating advanced intercompany processing framework, configuring advanced shipping notification (ASN), and defining automated invoicing in background.

compare_groups.name: Document & Order Configuration
compare_groups.covers: Purchasing document types, item categories, schedule line categories, and sales document linkage.

compare_groups.name: Delivery & Shipping Processing
compare_groups.covers: Outbound delivery types (NL, NLCC), shipping point determination, and route scheduling.

compare_groups.name: Billing & Financial Settlement
compare_groups.covers: Inter-company billing types (IV), customer/vendor master linkage, and pricing procedures.

compare_groups.name: Goods Movements & Inventory
compare_groups.covers: Movement types (641, 101, 301, 303), one-step vs two-step logic, and transit stock visibility.

compare_groups.name: OTC Integration & Monitoring
compare_groups.covers: Handling stuck deliveries, billing blocks, pricing errors, and OTC output management.
